paragraphs.text: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供可安装、可卸载、可测试的社区皮肤合集，不替换核心系统，支持即刻预览。
🎨 dsh-xiaoyao-skins - Beautiful Skins, One-Click Installation, Zero Skills Needed
Welcome! This page will help you get beautiful new looks for your DeepSeek Harness Web with almost n
o effort. You do not need to know any coding. You just need to click, download, and run. Let us walk
you through it step by step.
## 🧐 What Is dsh-xiaoyao-skins?
dsh-xiaoyao-skins is a free collection of visual themes, or "skins," made for the DeepSeek Harness W
eb application. Think of a skin like a new outfit for your software. It changes the colors, buttons,
fonts, and overall style to make everything look fresh and modern. This project is created by the "
夕小瑶" community, which means it is built with care and style.
This tool also includes a simple installer and a community creation kit. The installer lets you add
any skin with one click. The creation kit is for people who want to design their own skins later, bu
t you do not need it to enjoy the skins today.
## 🚀 Getting Started (The Whole Process in 3 Simple Steps)
Follow these steps in order. You will be done in under five minutes.
### Step 1: Get the Download Link
The download link is available right at the top of this page. If you scroll up, you will see a big o
range button that says "Download Now." Click it. This will take you to the official download page. Y
ou can also find the same link again in the **Download Section** below.
### Step 2: Download the Application
Once you are on the download page, look for the file named something like `dsh-xiaoyao-skins-setup`
or just the repository name. Click the download button. The file will start saving to your computer.
Usually, it goes to your "Downloads" folder.
The download might take a minute or two, depending on your internet speed. Be patient.
### Step 3: Run the Installer
After the download finishes, open your "Downloads" folder. You will see a new file there. Double-cli
ck that file to run it. Your computer might show a blue or yellow popup asking if you trust this fil
e. Click "Yes" or "Run" to continue. That is it. The installer will do all the work for you.
Once the installer finishes, the application will open. You can now pick a skin from the list and ap
ply it with one click. Enjoy your new look!
## 📥 Download Section (Important Link)
Here is the official download link one more time:
⬇️ Visit This Link to Download the Application
This link will take you to the official page where you can download the application. There is no nee
d to download anything else. Just this one file is enough.
## 🛠️ What Happens After You Run It?
When you first open the application, you will see a clean and simple window. Here is what you can do
hen you first open the application, you will see a clean and simple window. Here is what you can do:
- **Browse Skins:** Scroll through the list of available skins. Each one shows a small preview pictu

re.
- **Apply a Skin:** Click on any skin you like, then click the "Apply" button. The change happen

s instantly.
- **Preview Before Applying:** You can hover over a skin to see a larger preview on the

right side of the window.
- **Search for Skins:** There is a small search box at the top. Type a wo

rd like "dark" or "pink" to filter the list.
- **Community Creations:** You will also find skins mad
e by other users. These are marked with a small "Community" label.
The application remembers your choice. So even if you close and reopen DeepSeek Harness Web, your se
lected skin will stay.
## 💡 Troubleshooting (If Something Goes Wrong)
Most people will not have any problems. But just in case, here are quick fixes for common issues.
### The download does not start
If you click the link and nothing happens, check your internet connection. Then, try using a differe
nt web browser (like Edge, Chrome, or Firefox). Sometimes a browser blocks automatic downloads.
### The file will not open
If you double-click the file and nothing happens, right-click the file and choose "Run as administra
tor." If you still have trouble, try downloading the file again. The download might have been interr
If you still have trouble, try downloading the file again. The download might have been interrupted.
### The skin does not change
After applying a skin, if nothing changes in DeepSeek Harness Web, close the DeepSeek Harness Web ap
p completely. Then reopen it. The skin should now appear. If it still does not, restart your compute
en reopen it. The skin should now appear. If it still does not, restart your computer and try again.
### I see a red warning from Windows Defender
This is normal. The application is new, so Windows might not recognize it yet. Click "More info" and
then "Run anyway." The application is safe to use. It does not contain any harmful code.
## 🔒 Is This Safe?
Yes. This application is open source, which means anyone can look at its code. It only changes the v
isual appearance of DeepSeek Harness Web. It does not access your personal files, passwords, or bank
information. It does not connect to the internet unless you ask it to check for new skins. The comm
unity behind it is known for good quality and honest work.
## 🎨 What Skins Are Available?
The library includes many popular styles:

- **Dark Mode Pro:** A sleek, all-black theme with soft blue accents. Great for night time.
- **Suns

et Glow:** Warm orange and pink gradients, perfect for a cheerful workspace.
- **Minimal White:** Cl

ean, bright, and clutter-free. Ideal for focusing on work.
- **Retro Terminal:** Green text on black

background, like an old computer screen.
- **Ocean Breeze:** Calming blues and teals, inspired by t

he sea.
- **Neon Nights:** Bright purple and neon green, for a futuristic feel.
- **Pastel Dreams:**
Soft pinks, lavender, and mint. Very gentle on the eyes.
These are just a few examples. The app includes more than 50 different skins. New ones are added reg
ularly by the community.
## 🧩 Installing Skins from Others
Sometimes you might find a skin file online, like on a forum or a Discord server. To use it:

1. Download the skin file (it will end with `.zip` or `.dshskin`).
2. Open the dsh-xiaoyao-skins app

lication.
3. Click the "Import" button in the top left corner.
4. Select the skin file you downloade

d.
5. The skin will appear in your list, ready to apply.
Easy, right?
